hero.label: Escape Self-Sabotage · Freebie
hero.titel: You know what you want. So why do you keep ending up with *the exact opposite?*
text: Some decisions are hard to make sense of in hindsight. Especially your own.
What if it's not a weakness at all, but a logic you just haven't cracked yet?
hero.notiz: Maybe not everything is as illogical as it seems …

wiedererkennen.titel: Do you know that feeling of somehow ending up *in the same place* again and again?
wiedererkennen.text: The situations change. The people change too. Only the outcome feels suspiciously familiar.

karten.label: Finances
karten.text: You work so hard that there really should be more left over by now. And yet it feels like your hamster wheel keeps spinning faster and faster, and you have to do even more just to live a normal life. There's not much left for you.

karten.label: Relationships
karten.text: Different people, different stories, everything was different this time. And yet, at some point, there it was again: that familiar feeling that everything is slipping away from you once more, and that somewhere along the way, you lost yourself.

karten.label: Body & Well-Being
karten.text: Your mind is made up. And you're disciplined. This time, you're finally getting the results you want. Until they stop coming and your old pattern takes the wheel again, even though, deep down, you know better by now.
